CustomField.label: Ticket Type
CustomField.description: The Event_Ticket_Type__c record selected for this registration. Drives the Ticket_Price__c population via a Before Save Flow in Epic 4. Delete constraint set to Restrict — a Ticket Type cannot be deleted while registrations reference it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select the ticket category for this registration. The price will be set automatically based on the ticket type selected.
